neighbours.label: ' that' introducing a relative clause after an abstract noun (a culture that, in a manner that)
fire: A culture that values honesty needs clear rules.
Records must be kept in a manner that protects privacy.
This is a system that rewards hard work and skill.
We need a policy that treats every worker fairly.
Build an environment that encourages open discussion.
Data must be stored in a way that ensures safety.
It is a tradition that shapes the whole community.
She created a climate that supports young teachers.
quiet: A dog that barks needs a long walk and clear rules.
Records must be kept in a cabinet near the door.
This is a mouse that eats seeds and small bugs.
We need a truck that carries every box safely.
Build a shed that holds the bikes and tools.
Data must be stored in a box near the wall.
It is a bird that lives near the whole lake.
She bought a coat that fits her young daughter.

notes: Card: ' that' x5, ' by' x4, ' and' x2, ' to' x2, ' University', ' she'. Probes weak: ' that' 0.176, 0.145; ' she' 0.110; 'A dog that' under 0.01. Median likely short of the bar.
